records.purpose: Deliver learning continuity and evidence-linked adaptation
records.retention: user-controlled; provide export and deletion workflow
records.sharing: off by default; no secondary use without separate consent
records.sensitivity: ordinary personal data; context may increase sensitivity

records.default_storage: on-device first; sync only if user enables it
records.retention: user-controlled; history supports undo and estimation but can be pruned
records.sharing: never share with peers, advertisers or project collaborators by default
records.sensitivity: can reveal movements, relationships and daily patterns; treat as high sensitivity

records.purpose: Only the specific user-requested learning or safety function
records.default_storage: local-only by default; collect the minimum
records.sharing: no coach/guardian/AI sharing without deliberate user action except emergency/legal duty handled by humans
records.sensitivity: sensitive; no diagnosis or trait inference

records.purpose: Only where essential to an explicitly requested feature
records.default_storage: separate from learning evidence; avoid collection where possible
records.sharing: explicit audience and purpose; never public by default
records.sensitivity: high; exact location and contact details should be excluded from analytics

records.purpose: Evidence only when modality is necessary or user chooses it
records.sharing: item-level permission; child assent plus guardian approval where required
records.sensitivity: high; biometric identification or public dissemination is out of scope

records.purpose: Not required by ATHENA learning records
records.retention: never retain; if accidentally submitted, advise immediate rotation/revocation

records.purpose: Only approved learning/research activity with consent and minimisation
records.retention: defined before collection; delete on schedule
records.sensitivity: high; minors and sensitive topics require additional safeguards

records.default_storage: store minimal metadata, not full prompt by default
records.retention: user-controlled and linked to evidence record
records.sharing: not used to infer intelligence, diagnosis or personality
records.sensitivity: contextual; avoid prompt dumps containing private data
